thread:
maya: Quick check-in for GA readiness. Need explicit signoffs for SLA text, public docs, support rota, monitoring retention, and what's exposed on pricing. Target GA window: mid-May. Call out blockers now.
rj: SLA draft suggestion: Paid: 99.95% monthly availability, Trial: 99.9%. SLOs split by API surface: generation vs embeddings. Error-credit calc and maintenance windows need legal input.
anita: Support plan proposal: first 5 days post-GA -> reinforced coverage (two engineers/day overlap 10:00-20:00 PT). After that hand back to standard oncall. Will own the launch-pager channel and a 1-page triage cheat sheet.
leo: Docs: I'll update quickstarts (Py/JS/Go) and add a "Known limits at GA" section. Also drafting a migration note for customers on dedicated capacity who use pinning. ETA Tue EOD.
maya: Monitoring asks: keep metrics at 15s scrape for first 72h, traces 10d retention, logs 14d. Alerts we need: error_rate > 0.25% sustained 5m, p95 latency > 130ms sustained 10m, sudden cache-hit drop > 15% absolute. Also need a ModelQuality regression alert tied to eval-set.
rj: Rollback/fallback policy: prefer soft-fallback to a quantized-small variant, then degrade token limits for new sessions, then circuit-breaker to 429 for new sessions if errors persist. Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate > 3% for 8m OR p95 > 750ms for 10m.
anita: Support escalation path: launch-pager -> eng-sre -> infra lead -> CTO on-call. I'll pin escalation matrix and quick links to runbooks.
leo: Pricing readiness: plan to publish RU bands and a burst surcharge notice (e.g., >X RUs/s will incur surcharge). Need FinOps + Sales signoff before public page. Also including a short "what changes for Dedicated" blurb.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2024-05-12T06:00Z. Synthetic load: 140rps for 25m. Auto-rollback configured: error_threshold: 0.03, window: 480s. Alerts post to #launch-run and launch-pager.
maya: Risk list: (1) burst autoscale unexpected bills, (2) silent regressions from new tokenizer, (3) incomplete SDK examples. Actions: Rj -> SLA wording + rollback annex; Leo -> docs + SDK snippets; Anita -> support rota + runbook pins. Please ack by EOD Friday.
rj: Working on SLA PR now; will include per-route SLO appendix and sample credit calculation. PR: https://git.internal/sla/pull/5001
leo: Working on SDK quickstart PR with code example and migration note. PR: https://git.internal/docs/pull/6234
anita: I'll post the launch-pager rota tonight and pin the triage cheat sheet.
infra-bot: incident-bot: prelaunch runbook dry-run scheduled 2024-05-10T17:00Z. Participants: @oncall, @eng-sre, @product.
maya: If nobody flags scope changes we'll lock these defaults and stage the public launch page. Any objections?
rj: Ack. Sending legal review request after PR.
leo: Ack.
anita: Ack. Posting rota now.
maya: Thanks — dry-run Wed AM.
